results.title: Large Language Models: A Structured Taxonomy and ...
results.content: large language model; natural language processing; challenges of LLMs; comprehensive review; holistic survey; structured taxonomy Large language models (LLMs), as one of the most advanced and transformative tools of artificial intelligence (AI), have played an unparalleled role in the development of modern applications of natural language processing (NLP) [1]. In Section 4, the article delves into the more technical and specialized challenges related to the development and deployment of LLMs. This includes an analysis of issues such as fairness and bias mitigation, countering malicious attacks and potential misuse, integrating heterogeneous data, advancements in multimodal large language model research, supporting low-resource languages, ensuring continuous and stable learning in LLMs, and promoting ethical and responsible use of these technologies. Gallegos, I.O.; Rossi, R.A.; Barrow, J.; Tanjim, M.M.; Kim, S.; Dernoncourt, F.; Yu, T.; Zhang, R.; Ahmed, N.K. Bias and fairness in large language models: A survey. Anisuzzaman, D.M.; Malins, J.G.; Friedman, P.A.; Attia, Z.I. Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Specialized Use Cases.
